definitions.explanation: The process of producing alcoholic beverages (sake, beer, wine) or fermented foods (soy sauce, miso, vinegar) through controlled fermentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{醸造|じょうぞう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{醸造|じょうぞう}⟦{工程|こうてい}→工程：12415_koutei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I toured the beer brewing process.

examples.japanese: {醸造|じょうぞう}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{磨|みが}かれて→磨く：02427_migaku⟧きた。
examples.english: Brewing techniques have been refined over hundreds of years.

notes:
A compound of {醸|じょう} (to brew, to ferment) and {造|ぞう} (to make, to create). Functions as both a noun and a suru-verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {醸造|じょうぞう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to brew, to ferment)
- {醸造所|じょうぞうしょ} (brewery)
- {醸造|じょうぞう}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (brewing technique)
- {醸造|じょうぞう}⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (brewed vinegar)
- {醸造|じょうぞう}{酒|しゅ} (brewed alcohol — as opposed to distilled)

Covers a broader range than the English "brewing" since it includes the fermentation of soy sauce (⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧), miso (⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧), and vinegar (⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧) in addition to alcoholic beverages. Japan has a long tradition of {醸造|じょうぞう} culture, with many regional breweries and fermented food producers.
